SELECT 'class1' AS classTag, ci.id AS classId, ci.class_name AS className, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount, AVG(s.score) AS avgScore, ( SELECT AVG(score) FROM ( SELECT score FROM score s2 INNER JOIN student st2 ON s2.student_id = st2.id WHERE s2.course_id = #{courseId} AND st2.class_id = ci.id AND s2.score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY score LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score s3 INNER JOIN student st3 ON s3.student_id = st3.id WHERE s3.course_id = #{courseId} AND st3.class_id = ci.id AND s3.score IS NOT NULL) % 2 OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM score s4 INNER JOIN student st4 ON s4.student_id = st4.id WHERE s4.course_id = #{courseId} AND st4.class_id = ci.id AND s4.score IS NOT NULL) ) AS mid ) AS medianScore, STDDEV(s.score) AS stdDevScore, SUM(CASE WHEN s.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.score) * 100 AS passRate FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id INNER JOIN class_info ci ON st.class_id = ci.id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} AND ci.id = #{class1Id} AND s.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ci.id, ci.class_name
UNION ALL
SELECT 'class2' AS classTag, ci.id AS classId, ci.class_name AS className, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount, AVG(s.score) AS avgScore, ( SELECT AVG(score) FROM ( SELECT score FROM score s2 INNER JOIN student st2 ON s2.student_id = st2.id WHERE s2.course_id = #{courseId} AND st2.class_id = ci.id AND s2.score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY score LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score s3 INNER JOIN student st3 ON s3.student_id = st3.id WHERE s3.course_id = #{courseId} AND st3.class_id = ci.id AND s3.score IS NOT NULL) % 2 OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM score s4 INNER JOIN student st4 ON s4.student_id = st4.id WHERE s4.course_id = #{courseId} AND st4.class_id = ci.id AND s4.score IS NOT NULL) ) AS mid ) AS medianScore, STDDEV(s.score) AS stdDevScore, SUM(CASE WHEN s.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.score) * 100 AS passRate FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id INNER JOIN class_info ci ON st.class_id = ci.id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} AND ci.id = #{class2Id} AND s.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ci.id, ci.class_name

SELECT s_curr.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, c.id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, s_prev.score AS prevScore, s_curr.score AS currScore, (s_prev.score - s_curr.score) AS dropScore, s_curr.semester AS semester, CASE WHEN (s_prev.score - s_curr.score) >= 30 THEN 'DANGER' WHEN (s_prev.score - s_curr.score) >= 20 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS alertLevel FROM score s_curr INNER JOIN score s_prev ON s_curr.student_id = s_prev.student_id AND s_curr.course_id = s_prev.course_id AND s_curr.create_time > s_prev.create_time INNER JOIN course c ON s_curr.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN student st ON s_curr.student_id = st.id WHERE (s_prev.score - s_curr.score) > #{threshold} AND s_curr.score IS NOT NULL AND s_prev.score IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM score s_mid WHERE s_mid.student_id = s_curr.student_id AND s_mid.course_id = s_curr.course_id AND s_mid.create_time > s_prev.create_time AND s_mid.create_time < s_curr.create_time ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM score_alert sa WHERE sa.student_id = s_curr.student_id AND sa.course_id = s_curr.course_id AND sa.prev_score = s_prev.score AND sa.curr_score = s_curr.score AND sa.status = 0 )
